cli.intro: OpenZipper — list, extract, create and verify zip and tar archives, entirely in-process.

cmd.extract: Extract an archive after path-safety and bomb checks
cmd.create: Create a zip or tar archive from files and folders
cmd.list: List archive entries with safety annotations
cmd.test: Verify that every entry can be read back
cmd.audit: Print the append-only capability audit history

opt.overwrite: Existing-file policy: error (default), skip or rename
opt.dryRun: Validate the archive and report the planned writes without touching the filesystem
opt.recurse: Extract nested archives into `<file>.extracted` up to the depth limit
opt.format: Archive format: zip, tar, tar-gz, tar-bz2 or tar-xz (inferred from the extension)
opt.limit: Max entries printed in human output
opt.title: GUI window title
opt.actor: Actor id recorded for every capability call (default: WAE_ACTOR_ID)
opt.actorKind: Actor kind: user or agent (default: WAE_ACTOR_KIND)
opt.actorSource: Actor entry point, for example cli, gui, plugin (default: cli)
opt.actorFilter: Only show audit records for this actor id
opt.capability: Only show audit records for this capability name
